name: agentguard
description: The security layer between AI agents and their actions. NEAR Hackathon 2026.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: npm run build && npm --prefix backend run start
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && (cargo test --manifest-path contract/Cargo.toml 2>$null || echo "[skip] cargo not found — install Rust to run contract tests")
